summary: Short frontend-only regression pass (iteration 4) on Rideau Rapids (10/20) with two real browser contexts. VERIFIED FIXED: (1) the CRITICAL 0x0 poker-table collapse - [data-testid="poker-table"] now measures exactly 900x450 with all 6 seat slots, community-card placeholders, pot pill and action panel correctly laid out and non-overlapping; (2) winner-banner renders in a bordered gold pill on a single line ('qaA1786528450 wins 40 · Two Pair'), does not overlap the hero hole cards, and next-hand-countdown ('Next hand in 4s') appears with the next hand auto-dealing ~4s later; (3) blinds regression fixed - across hands 3,4,5,6 (and 7-10 played) sb_seat != bb_seat every hand and both SB/BB and the dealer button alternate between the two seats; (4) Admin admin-user-count denominator now matches admin-stats (25 / 304 users vs USERS 304), search filters to 1/1, load-more pages 25 -> 50. Only cosmetic/minor issues remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Preflop BB-option (to_call == 0 but current_bet == 20) renders the aggressive action as 'BET 40' instead of 'RAISE TO 40'. Label logic uses toCall > 0 only; should also treat hand.current_bet > 0 as a raise.

Transient 'BET 0' with bet-input=0 / slider min=0 observed for a moment at the start of a hand (panel mounts with legal_actions={} so amount initialises to 0 before the first state frame). Never persisted in the measured loop (18/18 sampled states had correct min 20/40), but a user clicking during that flash would submit bet 0. Suggest disabling raise-button while min_raise_total is 0.

Only occupied seats expose data-testid="seat-{n}"; the four empty 'SEAT n' placeholders have no data-testid, so seat-2..seat-5 queries return null (they do render visually and are correctly positioned around the oval).
After a hand ends the pot pill shows 'POT 0' next to the winner banner instead of retaining the final pot amount, which looks broken next to 'wins 40'.

issues: Vertical balance is slightly top-heavy: header starts at y~208 and the hand info bar ends at y~770, leaving ~300px of empty black below vs ~150px above (justify-center is offset by the min-h calc). Cosmetic only.

Everything else looks correct: 900x450 felt oval, 6 seat slots, 5 board placeholders, gold-bordered winner pill, full-width (768px) action panel and hand info bar with proper 'HAND #10  STREET: SHOWDOWN  MIN RAISE: 20' spacing.

action_items: Optional polish: label BB-option raise as 'Raise to' (ActionPanel toCall>0 check should include hand.current_bet>0).
Optional polish: guard raise-button/bet-input against the transient amount=0 state on hand start.
Optional polish: add data-testid="seat-{n}" to empty seat placeholders for testability.
Optional polish: keep the final pot amount visible at showdown instead of 'POT 0'.
critical_code_review_comments: game.py legal_actions is returned for the viewer regardless of whose turn it is; the UI relies solely on the `disabled` prop to prevent out-of-turn clicks. Consider returning {} unless hand.to_act == viewer seat as defence in depth.
Add a size assertion (poker-table width > 400) to any UI smoke test so the 0x0 felt regression cannot ship again.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 requested regression items pass (layout, winner banner, blinds rotation, admin count/search/load-more)
